newsitem.title: USA: Great Lakes September load factor down.
newsitem.headline: Great Lakes September load factor down.

text.p: Great Lakes Aviation Ltd said Tuesday its passenger load factor dipped to 44 percent in September from 44.5 percent a year ago.
Revenue passenger miles rose to 24.7 million from 22.7 million a year ago, while available seat miles rose to 56.2 million from 51.0 million a year ago, the airline said.
For the year through September, passenger load factor dipped to 44.4 percent from 44.6 percent a year ago, the company said.
Revenue passenger miles were 224.7 million, up from 182.9 million, while available seat miles were 506.3 million, up from 409.7 million a year ago.
Great Lakes stock was up 1/4 at 3 on Nasdaq Tuesday.
